{"name": "run_python", "arguments": {"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Filter to treatment arm
df_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response rate by sex and severity
response_by_sex_severity = df_treatment.groupby(['sex', 'severity'])['responded'].mean() * 100

# Compute the actual response rates
f_mild = response_by_sex_severity.loc[('F', 'mild')]
f_moderate = response_by_sex_severity.loc[('F', 'moderate')]
f_severe = response_by_sex_severity.loc[('F', 'severe')]
m_mild = response_by_sex_severity.loc[('M', 'mild')]
m_moderate = response_by_sex_severity.loc[('M', 'moderate')]
m_severe = response_by_sex_severity.loc[('M', 'severe')]

# Compute stratum-specific differences (F - M)
mild_diff = f_mild - m_mild
moderate_diff = f_moderate - m_moderate
severe_diff = f_severe - m_severe

# Compute weights: proportion of each severity level in treatment arm
weights = df_treatment['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Compute components
mild_component = mild_diff * weights['mild']
moderate_component = moderate_diff * weights['moderate']
severe_component = severe_diff * weights['severe']

# Compute adjusted difference
adjusted_diff = mild_component + moderate_component + severe_component

# Print all required values
print(f'Adjusted difference (F - M) in response rate: {adjusted_diff:.6f} percentage points')
print(f'Stratum-specific differences (F - M): mild = {mild_diff:.6f}, moderate = {moderate_diff:.6f}, severe = {severe_diff:.6f}')
print(f'Severity weights (proportions): mild = {weights["mild"]:.6f}, moderate = {weights["moderate"]:.6f}, severe = {weights["severe"]:.6f}')
print(f'Component 1 (mild): {mild_component:.6f}')
print(f'Component 2 (moderate): {moderate_component:.6f}')
print(f'Component 3 (severe): {severe_component:.6f}')"}}
